board.title: 买家最喜欢什么
board.lead: 装上就稳、单手能顺，是这批样本最硬的正面。

l2.name: 手机夹得稳颠簸不晃不掉
l2.desc: 机械夹持压过磁吸：烂路、急弯都不掉，是全类目第一卖点。

excerpts.en: I’ve driven over some pretty bumpy roads, and my phone hasn't budged or rattled at all
excerpts.cn: 我开过不少烂路，手机一点没挪动、没响。

excerpts.en: This phone holder keeps it in place manually, and I've never once had my phone fall out of it
excerpts.cn: 这个支架靠机械夹持固定，手机从没掉出来过。

l2.name: 底座固定牢靠不脱落
l2.desc: 吸盘/金属钩把底座钉死在风口和玻璃上，重低音车厢也稳。

excerpts.en: I stuck this to a non-smooth dashboard surface, and it’s never come loose in several months or use
excerpts.cn: 我粘在非光滑的仪表台面上，用了几个月从没松过。

excerpts.en: I have very loud subs in my trunk and the mount holds very stable on the glass no problems or vibrations
excerpts.cn: 我后备箱低音炮很响，支架在玻璃上稳得很，没一点振动。

l2.name: 厚壳大机也夹得住
l2.desc: Otterbox 级厚壳照样夹稳，是买家反复点名的兼容性优势。

excerpts.en: holds my iphone 12 in an Otterbox Commuter case no problem
excerpts.cn: iPhone 12 套 Otterbox Commuter 壳照样夹得稳。

excerpts.en: opens wide enough to grip the phone in the case
excerpts.cn: 开口够大，带壳的手机也夹得住。

l2.name: 出风口金属钩比普通夹稳
l2.desc: Lamicall 的金属钩被拿来和弹片夹正面对比，钩住就不跑位。

excerpts.en: The metal hook design is probably my favorite part because it gives the mount a much more secure attachment to the vent compared with the simple clip-style mounts I’ve used before
excerpts.cn: 金属钩设计是我最喜欢的点，比之前用的简易弹片夹固定牢得多。

l2.name: 调好后不跑位不用反复调
l2.desc: 拧紧一次就长期保持，免维护是隐性加分项。

excerpts.en: Once tightened properly, it stays in position and doesn’t constantly need to be readjusted
excerpts.cn: 拧紧之后位置就不动了，不用反复调。

l2.name: 单手取放轻松
l2.desc: 放取不费手，是「用起来没存在感」的直接来源。

excerpts.en: I enjoy the practicality of being able to put the phone in and take it out with ease
excerpts.cn: 单手轻松放取手机，很实用。

excerpts.en: Extremely easy to place and remove the phone in the holder
excerpts.cn: 放取手机极其轻松。

l2.name: 一键释放快拆好用
l2.desc: iOttie 的锁释机构被夸到「没得挑」，被当成设计标杆。

excerpts.en: The lock and release mechanism is beyond compare, very easy to operate
excerpts.cn: 锁止和释放机构没得挑，操作非常简单。

excerpts.en: The button on the back that releases the side grips is very functional
excerpts.cn: 背面释放侧夹的按键非常好用。

l2.name: 材质扎实有质感
l2.desc: 低价位做出超预期质感，是「值」的主要论据。

excerpts.en: It feels much more premium than other mounts I’ve used in the past
excerpts.cn: 比我用过的其他支架质感好得多。

excerpts.en: The material feels solid
excerpts.cn: 材质摸着扎实。

l2.name: 结构结实耐用
l2.desc: 一年半到两年的长测仍在服役，耐久有实证。

excerpts.en: I've had this dashboard-mounted phone holder for over a year and a half
excerpts.cn: 这个仪表台支架我用了一年半多了。

l2.name: 设计合理用心
l2.desc: 「设计师用心了」——工学细节被单独点名。

excerpts.en: Some design engineer really thought this out well
excerpts.cn: 设计师是真的用心了。

board.title: 差评主要抱怨什么
board.lead: 样本无 1–3 星：抱怨全部藏在 4–5 星里，按频次降序。

l2.name: 出风口叶片特殊装不上或难钩
l2.desc: 圆角风口（F150）、深叶片车型钩不进去，是出风口式的头号门槛。

excerpts.en: it unfortunately does not fit the rounded vents to my 2007 F150
excerpts.cn: 可惜装不进我 2007 F150 的圆角出风口。

excerpts.en: the vent vanes were quite deep and the hook had difficulty getting back far enough to grasp on
excerpts.cn: 出风口叶片很深，钩子很难伸到底卡住。

l2.name: 大屏厚壳夹不进或顶到按键
l2.desc: 旗舰大机+重型壳会顶侧键，有人被迫裁胶垫、掰夹臂。

excerpts.en: it barely had room for a Google Pixel 8 Pro in a Poetic Revolution Case.  The rubber pad has to be trimmed so that it won't press the Volume Down button
excerpts.cn: Pixel 8 Pro 套 Poetic 壳勉强放得下，得裁胶垫才不压音量减键。

excerpts.en: Sometimes pushed side volume/power buttons without my permission
excerpts.cn: 有时会误压侧边的音量/电源键。

l2.name: 背胶或吸盘在仪表台粘不住
l2.desc: 皮纹/软质仪表台是背胶和吸盘的盲区，买家只能换位置。

excerpts.en: the self-adhesive mount won't hold. I even tried using alien tape, but the tape doesn't stick to the holder mount
excerpts.cn: 背胶底座粘不住，我试了外星胶带也粘不上。

excerpts.en: Did not hold Will on my dash. Does great on windshield not where I wanted to use it of course
excerpts.cn: 仪表台上粘不住，挡风玻璃上倒是很好——可那不是我想要的位置。

l2.name: 高温背胶或吸盘失效脱落
l2.desc: 夏天挡风玻璃、亚利桑那车内高温直接让胶和吸盘投降。

excerpts.en: when it is too hot like during summer, it falls off the windshield
excerpts.cn: 夏天太热时它会从挡风玻璃上掉下来。

excerpts.en: the adhesive has some problems with releasing when warm (I live in Arizona so heat is a normal)
excerpts.cn: 天热时背胶会脱（我住亚利桑那，热是常态）。

l2.name: 长期日晒老化发黄
l2.desc: 两年暴晒后吸盘发黄失吸，寿命有明确天花板。

excerpts.en: After 2-years of using it and directly exposed to the heat of the sun, the suction becomes yellowish
excerpts.cn: 用了两年天天暴晒，吸盘发黄老化。

l2.name: 低温开合迟钝
l2.desc: 冷天电动夹臂开合变迟钝，北方冬季是隐性门槛。

excerpts.en: Has a little trouble opening occasionally when the weather is cold
excerpts.cn: 天冷时偶尔开合不利索。

l2.name: 夹力偏松或托架用料廉价
l2.desc: 底座稳但托架缩水：夹力偏松、塑料感强，被点名「cheaply made」。

excerpts.en: Very sturdy but the phone holder is cheaply made
excerpts.cn: 臂和吸盘很结实，但托架用料廉价。

excerpts.en: I wish it held my phone a little tighter
excerpts.cn: 希望夹得再紧一点。

l2.name: 过减速带或颠簸晃动
l2.desc: 吸盘臂式过坎有杠杆晃动，长臂是双刃剑。

excerpts.en: hate that it wiggles when u hit speed bumps
excerpts.cn: 讨厌过减速带时会晃。

l2.name: 静音时有吱呀异响
l2.desc: 塑料件间旷量带来的异响，安静车厢里很显眼。

excerpts.en: It is a little creaky if you’re sitting in silence
excerpts.cn: 安静坐在车里时会有点吱呀响。

l2.name: 小毛病不断
l2.desc: 夹臂自动合上、过热停充、残胶难清——单个都不致命，叠起来磨好感。

excerpts.en: when the phone is removed they automatically close. I'd prefer it if they stayed open and ready for the phone to be reinserted
excerpts.cn: 手机一取夹臂就自动合上，我更希望它保持张开待用。

excerpts.en: it was a B**ch to get all the melted but super sticky adhesive off the suction. I had to soak in Alcohol and it helped
excerpts.cn: 融化的残胶又黏又难清，泡酒精才弄掉。

l2.name: 装进出风口后难取下
l2.desc: 钩得太牢带来反向问题：想换位置时拆不下来。

excerpts.en: once I hooked it into my vent, I was unable to remove it
excerpts.cn: 钩进出风口后我取不下来了。

l2.name: 说明书或旋钮难懂
l2.desc: 双旋钮分居两处，说明书没讲清，学习成本被抱怨。

excerpts.en: instructions are a little tricky. You have to read carefully considering there are two different knobs to adjust in different place
excerpts.cn: 说明书有点绕：两个旋钮在不同位置，得仔细读。

board.title: 买家希望哪里更好
board.lead: 把 4–5 星里的抱怨翻成待办：先解决装不上，再解决夏天和冬天。

l2.name: 出风口叶片特殊装不上或难钩
l2.desc: 期待自带延长片/自适应钩臂，圆角深叶也一把装上。

excerpts.en: it unfortunately does not fit the rounded vents to my 2007 F150
excerpts.cn: 可惜装不进我 2007 F150 的圆角出风口。

l2.name: 背胶或吸盘在仪表台粘不住
l2.desc: 期待皮纹仪表台专用的强背胶或热熔贴片。

excerpts.en: the self-adhesive mount won't hold. I even tried using alien tape, but the tape doesn't stick to the holder mount
excerpts.cn: 背胶底座粘不住，我试了外星胶带也粘不上。

l2.name: 大屏厚壳夹不进或顶到按键
l2.desc: 期待大行程夹臂+可调垫位，旗舰机厚壳免改造直接用。

excerpts.en: it barely had room for a Google Pixel 8 Pro in a Poetic Revolution Case.  The rubber pad has to be trimmed so that it won't press the Volume Down button
excerpts.cn: Pixel 8 Pro 套 Poetic 壳勉强放得下，得裁胶垫才不压音量减键。

l2.name: 高温背胶或吸盘失效脱落
l2.desc: 期待耐高温胶系+可替换胶贴，暴晒车厢不掉。

excerpts.en: when it is too hot like during summer, it falls off the windshield
excerpts.cn: 夏天太热时它会从挡风玻璃上掉下来。

l2.name: 低温开合迟钝
l2.desc: 期待宽温标定的电动夹臂，冷车也顺滑。

excerpts.en: Has a little trouble opening occasionally when the weather is cold
excerpts.cn: 天冷时偶尔开合不利索。

board.title: 哪些人群 / 场景更适合
board.lead: 从好评侧看：谁的出风口规整、谁跑烂路、谁要隔壳充电，谁就买得值。

l2.name: 多种底座配件适配不同车
l2.desc: 全家多车型、多位置的「一套通用」人群吃这套。

excerpts.en: It came with the suction cup mount with an adjustable arm and swiveling phone grip along with several other attachments. For my Chrysler, the best option is the air vent mount due to the leather and soft vinyl dashboard
excerpts.cn: 带吸盘臂、旋转夹和好几种附件。我的克莱斯勒是皮质软仪表台，出风口装最合适。

excerpts.en: With three methods to mount the phone holder it should work for any vehicle
excerpts.cn: 三种安装方式，什么车都能装。

l2.name: 开箱安装简单
l2.desc: 不想折腾的人：撕膜即贴、卡上即用。

excerpts.en: It comfortably fits the vents. Easy to set up
excerpts.cn: 出风口装得服帖，设置简单。

excerpts.en: Easy install
excerpts.cn: 安装简单。

l2.name: 多车多场景都能用
l2.desc: 卡车+轿车+船+三脚架的极客复用党。

excerpts.en: Have one in my truck, wife's car, remanufactured 2 for my boat and to mount a phone on a cameras tripod
excerpts.cn: 我卡车一辆、老婆车一辆，还改了两个分别装船上和相机三脚架上。

l2.name: 手机夹得稳颠簸不晃不掉
l2.desc: 卡车/货车/箱车司机：振动大、烂路多，最需要机械夹持。

excerpts.en: I drive a truck, and the vibrations and rough roads kill the charging port on my phones. these hold tight
excerpts.cn: 我开卡车，振动和烂路很毁充电口，这款夹得很紧。

l2.name: 隔着手机壳也能充
l2.desc: 带壳无线充刚需人群，别家充不进这款能充。

excerpts.en: Charges my phone even through the case which has been a problem with other wireless chargers
excerpts.cn: 隔着手机壳也能充，其他无线充都有这问题。

l2.name: 电动夹臂省心
l2.desc: 喜欢自动化体验的尝鲜党：放上自动夹紧。

excerpts.en: it automatically clamps around my phone, it's very sturdy
excerpts.cn: 自动夹住手机，很稳。

board.title: 哪些情况不适合
board.lead: 从差评侧看：特殊风口、皮纹仪表台、极端温差，买前先对号入座。

l2.name: 出风口叶片特殊装不上或难钩
l2.desc: 圆角风口（老 F150 等）、深叶片车型：出风口式慎入。

excerpts.en: it unfortunately does not fit the rounded vents to my 2007 F150
excerpts.cn: 可惜装不进我 2007 F150 的圆角出风口。

l2.name: 背胶或吸盘在仪表台粘不住
l2.desc: 皮纹/软质仪表台：背胶和吸盘方案基本没戏，直接上出风口。

excerpts.en: Did not hold Will on my dash. Does great on windshield not where I wanted to use it of course
excerpts.cn: 仪表台上粘不住，挡风玻璃上倒是很好——可那不是我想要的位置。

l2.name: 大屏厚壳夹不进或顶到按键
l2.desc: Pixel/旗舰+重型壳用户：买前量行程，或准备自己改。

excerpts.en: Sometimes pushed side volume/power buttons without my permission
excerpts.cn: 有时会误压侧边的音量/电源键。

l2.name: 高温背胶或吸盘失效脱落
l2.desc: 南方夏天/西南暴晒地区：背胶和吸盘是首要失效点。

excerpts.en: the adhesive has some problems with releasing when warm (I live in Arizona so heat is a normal)
excerpts.cn: 天热时背胶会脱（我住亚利桑那，热是常态）。

l2.name: 长期日晒老化发黄
l2.desc: 常年挡风玻璃暴晒：按 1–2 年耗材预期使用。

excerpts.en: After 2-years of using it and directly exposed to the heat of the sun, the suction becomes yellowish
excerpts.cn: 用了两年天天暴晒，吸盘发黄老化。

l2.desc: 「如宣传一样」「会推荐」是主流反馈，含复购。

excerpts.en: Works as advertised
excerpts.cn: 和宣传的一样。

excerpts.en: This is the second one I have ordered. I LOVE this charger
excerpts.cn: 这是我又回购的一台，太爱了。

l2.name: 价格低于预期效果好
l2.desc: $9 档被当成捡漏：低价做出高质感。

excerpts.en: It does not include a wireless charging coil, which is understandable for $9! This phone holder offers much more value than I expected
excerpts.cn: 9 美元没有无线充电线圈可以理解，但价值远超预期。

excerpts.en: don't let the low price fool you, they work great and hold up great
excerpts.cn: 别被低价骗了，好用又耐用。

excerpts.cn: 可惜装不进我 2007 F150 的圆角出风口。

improve.text: 包装内附延长钩片/垫片，F150 类圆角风口也能一把卡住。

excerpts.en: the vent vanes were quite deep and the hook had difficulty getting back far enough to grasp on
excerpts.cn: 出风口叶片很深，钩子很难伸到底卡住。

product.text: 自适应钩臂：钩深可调 + 软胶包角，圆角、深叶、竖叶通用。

excerpts.en: the vent vanes were quite deep and the hook had difficulty getting back far enough to grasp on
excerpts.cn: 出风口叶片很深，钩子很难伸到底卡住。

pains.name: 高温背胶或吸盘失效脱落

improve.text: 标注耐温等级（如 -20~80℃），高温地区引导用出风口款。

excerpts.en: the adhesive has some problems with releasing when warm (I live in Arizona so heat is a normal)
excerpts.cn: 天热时背胶会脱（我住亚利桑那，热是常态）。

improve.text: 售后随附替换胶贴，把「夏天掉了」从退货变成换贴。

excerpts.en: It worked amazing until the adhesive for the windshield started to melt and come off
excerpts.cn: 一直很好用，直到挡风玻璃的胶开始融化脱落。

product.text: 耐高温凝胶 + 双层吸盘结构，主打暴晒车厢不掉。

excerpts.en: when it is too hot like during summer, it falls off the windshield
excerpts.cn: 夏天太热时它会从挡风玻璃上掉下来。

pains.name: 大屏厚壳夹不进或顶到按键

improve.text: 详情页写明最大爪距与「含厚壳最大宽度」，附侧键避位示意。

excerpts.en: it barely had room for a Google Pixel 8 Pro in a Poetic Revolution Case.  The rubber pad has to be trimmed so that it won't press the Volume Down button
excerpts.cn: Pixel 8 Pro 套 Poetic 壳勉强放得下，得裁胶垫才不压音量减键。

product.text: 大行程夹臂 + 可调止位垫：旗舰机+重型壳免改造直用，不压侧键。

excerpts.en: Sometimes pushed side volume/power buttons without my permission
excerpts.cn: 有时会误压侧边的音量/电源键。

pains.name: 背胶或吸盘在仪表台粘不住

improve.text: 随附皮纹台专用热熔贴片，并把「光滑面才可吸」写进安装第一步。

excerpts.en: the self-adhesive mount won't hold. I even tried using alien tape, but the tape doesn't stick to the holder mount
excerpts.cn: 背胶底座粘不住，我试了外星胶带也粘不上。

product.text: 出风口/CD 口/座椅缝多元底座套装，皮纹台车型不用胶。

excerpts.en: Did not hold Will on my dash. Does great on windshield not where I wanted to use it of course
excerpts.cn: 仪表台上粘不住，挡风玻璃上倒是很好——可那不是我想要的位置。

pains.name: 夹力偏松或托架用料廉价

improve.text: 托架与臂同规格用料，别在末端看不见处缩水。

excerpts.en: Very sturdy but the phone holder is cheaply made
excerpts.cn: 臂和吸盘很结实，但托架用料廉价。

product.text: 二级锁紧 + 弹簧预压夹臂：夹力可调，颠路不松。

excerpts.en: I wish it held my phone a little tighter
excerpts.cn: 希望夹得再紧一点。

improve.text: 把吸盘/胶贴定位成 1–2 年耗材，定期推送替换装。

excerpts.en: After 2-years of using it and directly exposed to the heat of the sun, the suction becomes yellowish
excerpts.cn: 用了两年天天暴晒，吸盘发黄老化。

product.text: 抗 UV 材质吸盘 + 备件订阅装，面向日照强地区。

excerpts.en: After 2-years of using it and directly exposed to the heat of the sun, the suction becomes yellowish
excerpts.cn: 用了两年天天暴晒，吸盘发黄老化。

improve.text: 电动夹臂做宽温标定，北方冬季开合不迟钝。

excerpts.en: Has a little trouble opening occasionally when the weather is cold
excerpts.cn: 天冷时偶尔开合不利索。

improve.text: 臂关节加阻尼/限位，牺牲一点调节自由度换过坎稳定。

excerpts.en: hate that it wiggles when u hit speed bumps
excerpts.cn: 讨厌过减速带时会晃。

improve.text: 转动副加消音垫片，出厂做静音抽检。

excerpts.en: It is a little creaky if you’re sitting in silence
excerpts.cn: 安静坐在车里时会有点吱呀响。

improve.text: 钩件加快拆释放柄：装得牢也取得下。

excerpts.en: once I hooked it into my vent, I was unable to remove it
excerpts.cn: 钩进出风口后我取不下来了。

improve.text: 一图流安装卡：双旋钮各自作用 3 秒看懂。

excerpts.en: instructions are a little tricky. You have to read carefully considering there are two different knobs to adjust in different place
excerpts.cn: 说明书有点绕：两个旋钮在不同位置，得仔细读。

improve.text: 取机后夹臂保持张开（加记忆卡点），放上即充。

excerpts.en: when the phone is removed they automatically close. I'd prefer it if they stayed open and ready for the phone to be reinserted
excerpts.cn: 手机一取夹臂就自动合上，我更希望它保持张开待用。
